zh.title: 德國 AeroForce X 偵察機完成首飛 無人飛行測試時程未定
zh.summary: Aerodata 的 AeroForce X 原型機完成有人駕駛首飛，目標續航40小時，後續將逐步測試無人操作。
body: 德國 Aerodata 的 AeroForce X 偵察機原型機11月14日在布蘭登堡邦施特勞斯貝格機場完成首飛，開始飛行測試。此次由飛行員在機上操作；公司表示，操控、穩定性及關鍵系統測試均達成目標。
AeroForce X 定位為中高度長滯空無人航空系統，翼展26公尺，目標酬載能力為1.3公噸、續航最長40小時。這些數字是研發目標，並非此次首飛已驗證的性能。
公司規劃先進行更多有人駕駛飛行及自動駕駛測試，再展開首次無人飛行，目前尚未公佈日期。預定用途包括海上關鍵基礎設施監控等軍事及安全任務，模組化設計可搭載不同偵察設備。

en.title: Aerodata AeroForce X completes piloted maiden flight; unmanned test date unannounced
en.summary: The AeroForce X prototype has begun flight testing with a pilot on board, targeting up to 40 hours of endurance.
body: Germany’s Aerodata completed the maiden flight of its AeroForce X prototype at Strausberg Airport in Brandenburg on November 14. A pilot was on board. The company said tests of handling, stability and key systems met their objectives.

The aircraft is being developed as a medium-altitude, long-endurance unmanned system with a 26-metre wingspan. Its targets include a payload of up to 1.3 tonnes and endurance of up to 40 hours; these are development goals rather than performance demonstrated by this flight.

Further piloted flights and autopilot testing will precede unmanned operations. Aerodata has not announced a date for the first unpiloted flight. Intended military and security missions include surveillance of critical maritime infrastructure, using a modular design for different reconnaissance equipment.

image.subject: 漢莎航空 A320 D-AIQT 起飛資料照；非勞資協商現場。
image.description: Lufthansa Airbus A320-211 (reg. D-AIQT, cn 1337) taking off at Stuttgart Airport (EDDS/STR). The A320 series has two variants, the A320-100 and A320-200. Only 21 A320-100s were produced; these aircraft, the first to be manufactured, were only delivered to Air Inter (later acquired by Air France) and British Airways (as a result of an order from British Caledonian Airways made prior to its acquisition by British Airways). Compared to the A320-100, the primary changes on A320-200 are wingtip fences and increased fuel capacity for increased range. Indian Airlines used its first 31 A320-200s with double-bogie main landing gear for airfields with poor runway condition which a single-bogie main gear could not manage. Typical range with 150 passengers for the A320-200 is about 3,300 nmi (6,150 km). It is powered by two CFMI CFM56-5s or IAE V2500s with thrust ratings between 113 to 120 kN (25,400 to 27,000 lbf). The lowest speed an A320 can fly is approximately 207 km/h

zh.title: 漢莎航空機師合約僵局：工會設11月23日最後通牒
zh.summary: 漢莎航空向機師工會提出新聘僱方案，承諾2033年底前增聘最多1000名機師；工會批評資方拒絕調解人方案，要求11月23日前重新考慮。
body: 漢莎航空向德國機師工會「駕駛艙協會」提交一份關於機師工作條件與未來保障的聘僱方案，工會以失望回應。漢莎希望以2033年底前新增最多1000名機師、每年最多增加150名機長升遷名額的承諾，打破今年已多次引發罷工的僵局。
方案依據前邦總理博多·拉梅洛與羅蘭·科赫提出的建議，兩人分別由勞資雙方任命為仲裁人。建議內容包括暫時穩定薪資水準、調整薪級表與提高生產力的措施；變動薪酬部分也將調整，2027年與2028年發放一次性給付，2029年起調薪。已於2026年4月停運的漢莎城市航線機師，則獲得轉調漢莎航空等具體就業前景。
工會指出，調解人方案已包含凍薪、減少加班費與大幅削減變動薪酬等重大經濟讓步，並以長期規劃保障、部分改善、工作保障與城市航線員工前景作為交換；工會發言人阿恩·卡斯滕斯表示，經過18輪密集調解談判，具體方案已擺在桌上，資方如今拒絕令人完全無法理解。工會要求漢莎在11月23日前重新考慮立場、依調解人方案推動具體落實，並表示接下來取決於資方是否願意讓步。

en.title: Lufthansa pilot contract deadlock as union sets November 23 deadline
en.summary: Lufthansa has offered its pilots' union a new employment deal promising up to 1,000 hires by 2033, but Vereinigung Cockpit says the airline is rejecting the mediator's proposal and has set a November 23 deadline.
body: Lufthansa has submitted an employment proposal to Germany's Vereinigung Cockpit union covering pilots' working conditions and future job security, and the union has reacted with frustration. The airline said the offer, presented on November 17, 2026, promises up to 1,000 new pilot hires by the end of 2033 and up to 150 additional captain promotions a year, in an attempt to break a deadlock that has already led to strikes on multiple occasions this year.

The proposal is based on recommendations from former state premiers Bodo Ramelow and Roland Koch, each appointed as an arbitrator by one side. The recommendations include temporarily stabilising pay levels, adjusting salary scales and raising productivity, alongside changes to variable pay, a one-off payment for 2027 and 2028, and salary increases from 2029. Pilots of Lufthansa CityLine, which ceased operations in April 2026, were offered "concrete employment prospects", including the option of transferring to Lufthansa.

Vereinigung Cockpit says the airline is rejecting a mediator's proposal that attempted to reconcile both sides, even though it already contained significant economic concessions from pilots, including pay freezes, reduced overtime compensation and substantial cuts to variable pay, in exchange for planning security, partial improvements, job protection and prospects for CityLine staff. The union said Lufthansa has until November 23, 2026 to reconsider and work towards implementing the mediator's proposal. "The ball is now in the employer's court," said union spokesperson Arne Karstens.

zh.title: 美國航空A321neo機隊增至90架 預期年底前再接收3架A321家族飛機
zh.summary: 美國航空A321neo機隊達90架，年底前預期再接收3架A321家族飛機。
body: 根據Simple Flying的報導，美國航空的空中巴士A321neo機隊規模已增至90架。這一數字指的是航空公司目前的A321neo機隊，不包括仍在預期中的額外交付飛機。
美國航空預計在2026年底之前，另接收3架A321家族飛機。報導另外指出，這些預期交付的飛機中，2架為A321neo，另1架為A321XLR。

en.title: American Airlines A321neo fleet reaches 90; three more A321-family aircraft expected by year-end
en.summary: American Airlines’ A321neo fleet reaches 90; three more A321-family aircraft are expected by year-end.
body: American Airlines’ fleet of Airbus A321neo aircraft has grown to a total of 90, according to a report published by Simple Flying. The current figure refers to the carrier’s existing fleet rather than the additional aircraft it expects to receive later.

By the end of 2026, the airline expects to take delivery of three more aircraft from the A321 family, the publication reported. Those anticipated deliveries comprise two additional A321neo aircraft and one A321XLR.
